semantic_incompatibilities.disposition: The upstream deposit() positive carries one trailing calldata byte. PQ1 must and does refuse it; it is retained as an explicit negative, never waived into a positive transcript match.

ledger_interaction_with.disposition: Ledger-owned envelope presentation; preserve and classify, but do not require a byte-identical PQ1 page.

ledger_max_fees.disposition: Ledger-owned fee presentation; PQ1 fee pages are checked by the transaction-display tests, not treated as descriptor output.

empty_expected_texts.disposition: Inventory-only. Never count as positive transcript coverage.

odd_expected_text_count.disposition: Do not infer alternating label/value pairs; retain ordered strings until a typed semantic projection exists.

line_wrapped_address_like.disposition: Normalize spaces only after validating and reconstructing one complete address.

line_wrapped_numeric.disposition: Reconstruct digit wrapping without erasing the semantic amount/ticker separator.

unresolved_ticker.disposition: `???` is non-authoritative presentation output and cannot establish token identity.

truncated_more.disposition: `... More` is a lossy Ledger snapshot and cannot establish full-value equality.

over_pq1_page.disposition: Values longer than one 4x16 PQ1 page require an explicit multi-page or digest comparison; no clipping waiver is implied.
